beats.label: S1 · The plane returns
beats.text: Montego Air Flight 828 lands after five and a half missing years with its passengers unaged; several begin hearing 'Callings' that push them to save strangers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the show's premise: the returnees, the missing time, and the voices that will drive every arc.

beats.label: S1 · A shared blood marker
beats.text: Saanvi finds a chemical marker in her own and Cal's blood, then in every returnee tested; the NSA under Robert Vance opens a covert file on all of them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms the passengers are physically changed and sets the government hunt in motion.

beats.label: S1 · The Singularity Project
beats.text: Ben discovers eleven passengers were secretly taken by a private lab experimenting on their Callings, run by a shadowy US Army officer called 'the Major.'
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's antagonist and the weaponisation stakes attached to the Callings.

beats.label: S1 · A marriage buckles
beats.text: Ben's marriage collapses after he learns Grace was with a man named Danny during his absence; Michaela sleeps with Jared, ending his marriage to her old best friend Lourdes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Ben-Grace-Danny triangle and the Michaela-Jared affair are the family conflicts driving S2.

beats.label: S1 · The lab is raided
beats.text: Ben and Vance raid the Major's warehouse and free the eleven; the operation ends with Vance reported dead in the explosion, cutting off Ben's inside line to the government.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the passengers' most powerful ally and hardens the Major into a faceless threat.

beats.label: S1 · The Death Date
beats.text: Passenger James Griffin dry-drowns exactly 82 hours 8 minutes after returning - the length he was missing. Ben calculates every 828 passenger will die on June 2, 2024.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Death Date is the clock the rest of the series runs against.

beats.label: S1 · Zeke walks out of a cave
beats.text: A frostbitten stranger, Zeke, emerges from a mountain cave carrying the same blood marker as the 828ers; the season ends with a gunshot in Michaela's apartment when he fights Jared.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Zeke is the new lead into S2 and proves the 828 phenomenon isn't unique to the plane.

cliffhanger.text: Zeke has walked out of a cave with the same blood marker as the 828 passengers, proving the phenomenon isn't unique to the flight. In Michaela's apartment, a fight between Zeke and Jared triggers an off-camera gunshot, and the Death Date - June 2, 2024 - now hangs over everyone.
questions: Who was hit by the gunshot in Michaela's apartment?
If a lone hiker returned the same way, what actually caused Flight 828 to disappear?
Can the passengers do anything to change the Death Date, or is it fixed?

characters.name: Ben Stone
characters.line: Passenger and family patriarch; leads the investigation into what happened to Flight 828 as his marriage collapses.

characters.name: Michaela Stone
characters.line: Ben's sister and an NYPD officer; hearing Callings and sleeping again with her ex-fiancé Jared.

characters.name: Cal Stone
characters.line: Ben's ten-year-old son and a passenger; terminally ill with cancer, on Saanvi's experimental treatment. His Callings work differently to the adults'.

characters.name: Grace Stone
characters.line: Ben's wife; moved on with a man named Danny during his absence and is now pregnant, unsure who the father is.

characters.name: Saanvi Bahl
characters.line: Passenger and medical researcher; identified the shared blood marker in returnees and is treating Cal.

characters.name: Jared Vasquez
characters.line: Michaela's ex-fiancé and NYPD partner; married her best friend Lourdes during Michaela's missing years.

characters.name: Robert Vance
characters.line: NSA official heading the government investigation of Flight 828; presumed killed in the raid on the Major's lab.

characters.name: Zeke Landon
characters.line: Frostbitten stranger just emerged from a mountain cave with the same blood marker as the passengers.

characters.name: The Major
characters.line: Unseen US Army officer running secret experiments on the eleven vanished passengers.

beats.label: S2 · Vance is alive
beats.text: Michaela survives the gunshot and Zeke turns himself in; Vance is revealed alive, faking his death so he can keep hunting the Major off-books.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the pieces after the S1 cliffhanger and restores Ben's key ally as a secret asset.

beats.label: S2 · The Major has a name
beats.text: Saanvi identifies the Major as US Army general Kathryn Fitz, who had been posing as her therapist to steal her research on the passengers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts a face and a name on the season's antagonist and personalises Saanvi's arc.

beats.label: S2 · The baby is Ben's
beats.text: A shared Calling proves Grace's baby is Ben's, not Danny's; the family reunites, and Ben starts treating every Calling as gospel to protect the 'lifeboat' of all 828ers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reconciles the marriage and gives Ben the doctrine that will define his behaviour for years.

beats.label: S2 · The Xers
beats.text: An anti-828 movement called the Xers, led by Simon White, terrorises passengers; Jared goes undercover with them and burns his career doing it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the civilian backlash the passengers now face and shifts Jared's standing with Michaela.

beats.label: S2 · Onto the ice
beats.text: Three meth heads - Jace, Pete, Kory - kidnap Cal and chase him onto a frozen lake; all fall through, and only Cal is pulled out alive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the three men whose apparent deaths open the next season's central puzzle.

beats.label: S2 · Beating the Death Date
beats.text: Zeke drowns saving Cal but resurrects free of hypothermia and free of his own Death Date - proof following the Callings works. He and Michaela have just married.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gives the passengers a template for survival and locks Zeke into the family.

beats.label: S2 · The tailfin
beats.text: Saanvi poisons Kathryn Fitz to interrogate her, then kills her by accident when the antidote breaks. Hours later, a Cuban boat pulls Flight 828's tailfin from the ocean.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Loads Saanvi with a secret killing and reveals the plane the passengers landed in was already wreckage.

cliffhanger.text: Saanvi has killed Kathryn Fitz by accident and is hiding it from Vance and everyone else. A Cuban fishing boat has just hauled Flight 828's tailfin from the ocean, meaning the plane the passengers landed in was already wreckage.
questions: If the real Flight 828 crashed into the ocean, what returned to Stewart Airport with its passengers alive?
Can Saanvi's cover-up of Fitz's death hold, and what will Jared find if he keeps digging?
Can other passengers replicate Zeke's resurrection and escape the June 2, 2024 Death Date?

characters.name: Ben Stone
characters.line: Passenger; treats every Calling as gospel to protect the 'lifeboat' of all 828ers, reconciled with Grace.

characters.name: Michaela Stone
characters.line: NYPD detective; recovered from the gunshot, married Zeke on the day he was meant to die.

characters.name: Cal Stone
characters.line: Ben's son; his kidnapping drove the finale.

characters.name: Grace Stone
characters.line: Ben's wife; back with him after paternity was resolved, mother to newborn Eden.

characters.name: Saanvi Bahl
characters.line: Researcher; killed Kathryn Fitz in a botched interrogation and is hiding it from everyone.

characters.name: Zeke Landon
characters.line: Michaela's husband; died at his own Death Date saving Cal and immediately came back, apparently cured.

characters.name: Jared Vasquez
characters.line: NYPD cop; burned his career going undercover with the Xers and lost Michaela's trust.

characters.name: Robert Vance
characters.line: Presumed dead but alive off the grid; running his own hunt for the Major.

characters.name: Kathryn Fitz / 'The Major'
characters.line: US Army general who ran the passenger experiments; dead by Saanvi's hand, cover-up in place.

characters.name: TJ Morrison
characters.line: Young 828 passenger studying with Ben; dating Ben's daughter Olive, then leaves for Egypt.

beats.label: S3 · The tailfin drops the veil
beats.text: Ben chases the tailfin to Cuba, where Vance is captured; Michaela's honeymoon is cut short to rescue devout passenger Angelina Meyer from her fanatical parents.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the tailfin at the centre of the season and introduces Angelina, the season's eventual killer.

beats.label: S3 · Out of the lake
beats.text: The three meth heads walk out of the thawed lake alive, months after drowning; a new passenger named Eagan Tehrani debuts - brilliant, prickly, and self-serving.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the season's central resurrection puzzle and introduces Eagan, a load-bearing figure to come.

beats.label: S3 · Eureka
beats.text: Vance now openly runs Eureka, a government lab studying 828; Saanvi keeps her killing of Fitz secret while Jared unknowingly starts dating Fitz's daughter Sarah.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Legitimises the government investigation and quietly winds a clock on Saanvi's secret.

beats.label: S3 · The lifeboat rule
beats.text: At their Death Date, Pete and Kory try to redeem themselves but Jace's murderous rage kills all three - proving the passengers rise or fall together as one 'lifeboat.'
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the moral rule Ben will spend the rest of the show trying to enforce.

beats.label: S3 · Noah's Ark
beats.text: Saanvi identifies the tailfin's mineral coating in a 6,000-year-old wood fragment from Mount Ararat - Flight 828 is somehow tangled with Noah's Ark.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes the show's mystery from sci-fi to scripture and seeds the sapphire mythology.

beats.label: S3 · Cal vanishes, Grace dies
beats.text: Eureka's tests on the tailfin burn Cal from inside; he touches the tailfin and disappears. Angelina, convinced Eden is her guardian angel, stabs Grace to death and takes the child.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two catastrophic losses that define the next season's trauma and Ben's obsession.

beats.label: S3 · An adult Cal and a ghost plane
beats.text: An adult version of Cal appears beside his dying mother; in Eureka, Captain Bill Daly - long presumed lost - flickers into view aboard a reconstructed Flight 828.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up S4's new lead role for adult Cal and reopens the question of where the passengers actually went.

cliffhanger.text: Grace lies stabbed by Angelina, who has taken Eden. Cal has vanished after touching the tailfin, then reappeared as an adult beside his dying mother, and Captain Bill Daly - long presumed lost - has flickered into view aboard a phantom Flight 828 in the Eureka lab.
questions: Where has Angelina taken Eden, and how will Ben ever find her?
Why has Cal returned as an adult, and does he remember where he went?
How can Bill Daly be aboard a plane that shouldn't exist, and where has he been?

characters.name: Ben Stone
characters.line: Grieving Grace and hunting Eden; obsessed with the tailfin, Eureka, and the Callings.

characters.name: Michaela Stone
characters.line: Back on the NYPD after her honeymoon, working the Callings alongside her marriage.

characters.name: Cal Stone
characters.line: Vanished when he touched the tailfin, then reappeared at season's end as an adult beside his dying mother.

characters.name: Grace Stone
characters.line: Ben's wife; stabbed to death by Angelina in her own home.

characters.name: Saanvi Bahl
characters.line: Working openly at Eureka; her cover-up of Fitz's killing still holds but is quietly grinding her down.

characters.name: Zeke Landon
characters.line: Michaela's husband; his second life gave him empathy powers that let him feel others' emotions and pain by touch.

characters.name: Angelina Meyer
characters.line: Passenger rescued from Costa Rica; came to believe Eden was her guardian angel, murdered Grace and abducted the child.

characters.name: Eagan Tehrani
characters.line: Newly introduced 828 passenger; brilliant, self-interested, willing to sell out other passengers when it suits him.

characters.name: Robert Vance
characters.line: Now openly runs the NSA's Eureka lab investigating Flight 828.

characters.name: Jared Vasquez
characters.line: NYPD cop; unknowingly dating Sarah Fitz, daughter of the woman Saanvi killed.

beats.label: S4 · Two years on
beats.text: Two years after Grace's murder, Ben is a broken shell still hunting Eden; Cal, who vanished touching the tailfin, has returned as an adult with a dragon-shaped scar on his arm.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the family's baseline and gives Cal the mark that ties him to the season's mythology.

beats.label: S4 · The black box
beats.text: Passenger Henry Kim smuggles Flight 828's black box to Cal; Saanvi finds it holds every Calling any passenger has ever received, encoded in six seconds of static.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gives the passengers their first tool to actually see the Callings whole and drives Cal's arc.

beats.label: S4 · The Registry and Eden's return
beats.text: A new 828 Registry forces every passenger to check in; Angelina resurfaces hiding with Eden at Adrian's compound, and Ben finally recovers his daughter when Angelina detonates it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Formalises the persecution the passengers now face and closes the Eden kidnapping arc.

beats.label: S4 · Zeke dies for Cal
beats.text: Cal's cancer returns; in the standoff over Eden, Zeke uses his empathy to absorb Cal's cancer into himself and dies. Angelina escapes with a shard of Omega Sapphire fused into her hand.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills a lead, saves another, and arms Angelina with the tool she will use to end the world.

beats.label: S4 · Detention and plagues
beats.text: NSA director Zimmer detains every passenger indefinitely; biblical plagues erupt inside the centre, and Angelina uses the sapphire to kill Fiona and taunt the returned Bill Daly into being shot dead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Traps the cast in one location, escalates Angelina to biblical-scale threat, and closes the Daly and Fiona mysteries.

beats.label: S4 · The Date is the end of the world
beats.text: Ben, Cal and Saanvi realise the June 2, 2024 Death Date is not just the passengers' end but the world's, and that every 828er will be judged when it arrives.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rewrites the stakes of every earlier season and sets up the finale's judgement.

beats.label: S4 · The plane returns to 2013
beats.text: On the Date, Flight 828 rises from a fissure; the passengers reboard, are judged - eleven turn to ash - and return to April 2013 with Cal a boy again and Grace, Zeke and every lost passenger alive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's answer: the passengers get the lives they thought they'd flown home to.

cliffhanger.text: On the Death Date, Flight 828 rose from a fissure, the passengers boarded and were judged - eleven turned to ash - and the plane returned intact to April 7, 2013. Everyone lost along the way is alive again; the returnees are stepping back into the lives they were meant to have, with Cal restored to boyhood and no memory of the years he lived.
questions: What was the shadowy figure that weighed each passenger's soul at the judgement?
Now that Cal has no memory of the years he lived, will Saanvi really be able to cure his leukemia?
What became of the eleven passengers who turned to ash - are they simply gone?

characters.name: Ben Stone
characters.line: Broken by Grace's murder and Eden's disappearance; leads the passengers through the last months to the Date.

characters.name: Michaela Stone
characters.line: NYPD cop; widowed by Zeke's death, holding the passengers' 'lifeboat' together with Ben.

characters.name: Cal Stone
characters.line: Returned as an adult with a dragon scar on his arm; his cancer comes back, and Zeke dies absorbing it.

characters.name: Saanvi Bahl
characters.line: Government-lab researcher; her science and her moral debts both come due before the Date.

characters.name: Zeke Landon
characters.line: Working as a therapist absorbing others' pain; dies mid-season taking Cal's cancer into himself.

characters.name: Angelina Meyer
characters.line: Increasingly unstable prophet with a shard of Omega Sapphire fused into her hand; sows the plagues inside the detention centre.

characters.name: Adrian
characters.line: Former passenger prophet; shelters Angelina and Eden at his compound, then pleads with her to stand down.

characters.name: Eagan Tehrani
characters.line: Passenger with his own Callings and his own agenda; briefly aligned with Angelina before turning back.

characters.name: Robert Vance
characters.line: Government insider quietly helping the passengers from the inside as the NSA cracks down.

characters.name: Jared Vasquez
characters.line: NYPD cop helping Michaela from outside the fence; in a new relationship with fellow cop Drea.
